t_advice_summary_textbox.text: yellow and red baskets alternate for the highest scoring mushrooms. each gnome corresponds to a certain colour. as the number of mushrooms decline best to switch to the alternate colour to score high. aim for the x 5 multipliers.

vb_textbox.text: Each different colour gnome is assigned to either a red or yellow basket. Learn which colour gnome is linked to both baskets. The x 5 multipliers get you more points. If you are earning a lot of mushrooms then stick with that colour basket. As soon as your points start to reduce switch baskets and ensure you choose the other colour gnomes.
